people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

translations.web: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.
translations.bsb: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.
translations.kjv: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
translations.asv: but I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
